moaSummary.value: Elemental zinc used in selected paediatric diarrhoea and deficiency pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent an elemental-mg dose or course length; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Alkalinising salt used in selected metabolic acidosis and urinary-alkalinisation contexts — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a mmol/kg dose or infusion rate; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Topical sulfonamide antiseptic used in selected burn-wound pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent an application thickness or dressing schedule; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Oral prodrug of ganciclovir used in selected paediatric CMV pathways — educational framing only. Myelosuppression risk applies. Materia does not invent a mg/kg dose or induction/maintenance switch; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Rifamycin antimycobacterial used in selected MAC and TB-adjacent pathways — educational framing only. Drug-interaction burden is high. Materia does not invent a dose or interaction list; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Osmotic laxative used in selected paediatric constipation pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a sachet dose or disimpaction schedule; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Sulfonamide used in selected toxoplasmosis combination pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a mg/kg dose or pyrimethamine pairing rule; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.
